pages.text: 早上，咘咘的心里出了大太阳。她想着今天的好事：猪猪姐姐要来玩，还可以吃冰淇淋，晚上还可以看冰雪奇缘。
pages.text_en: In the morning, there was a big sun in Bubu's heart. She thought about today's good things: Zhuzhu would come to play, there would be ice cream, and Frozen in the evening.

pages.text: 咘咘蹦蹦跳跳，心砰砰跳。妈妈说：“你看，高兴的时候，身体会跳起来，脸会笑，心会跳得快快的。”
pages.text_en: Bubu jumped up and down, her heart beating fast. Mummy said, "Look, when you are happy, your body jumps, your face smiles, and your heart beats fast."

pages.text: 下午，咘咘搭的积木塔哗啦倒了。她的胸口紧紧的，脸热热的，手紧紧握着。妈妈说：“你看，生气的时候，身体会变紧，脸会变热。”
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, Bubu's block tower crashed down. Her chest felt tight, her face felt hot, and her hands clenched. Mummy said, "Look, when you are angry, your body gets tight and your face gets hot."

pages.text: 晚上，天上打了一个响雷。咘咘缩到妈妈身边，小手抖抖的。妈妈说：“你看，害怕的时候，身体会缩起来，手会抖，想找大人抱抱。”
pages.text_en: At night, thunder rumbled. Bubu shrank beside Mummy, her little hands shaking. Mummy said, "Look, when you are scared, your body shrinks, your hands shake, and you want a hug."

pages.text: NOMI 拿来一张画着天气的卡片：“情绪就像天气。有晴天，有阴天，也会有小雨和暴雨。每一种天气都会来，也都会走。”
pages.text_en: NOMI brought a card with weather pictures. "Feelings are like weather. There are sunny days, cloudy days, light rain and rainstorms. Every weather comes, and every weather goes."

pages.text: 咘咘指着卡片说：“早上我是晴天，下午我是暴雨，晚上我是小雨。一天里，我的心里可以有好几种天气！”
pages.text_en: Bubu pointed at the card. "In the morning I was sunny, in the afternoon I was a rainstorm, and at night I was light rain. In one day, my heart can have many kinds of weather!"

pages.text: 妈妈说：“情绪没有好坏。生气、高兴、害怕，都是真的，都是可以说的。说出来，别人才能听见你。”
pages.text_en: Mummy said, "Feelings are not good or bad. Angry, happy, scared — they are all real, and they can all be said. When you say them, others can hear you."

pages.text: NOMI 教咘咘四个小工具：“第一，暂停一下，按一下手掌。第二，闻花吹蜡烛，慢慢呼吸。第三，把话说出来。第四，请大人帮忙。”
pages.text_en: NOMI taught Bubu four little tools: "First, pause, press your palm. Second, smell a flower and blow out a candle, breathing slowly. Third, say the words out loud. Fourth, ask a grown-up for help."

pages.text: NONO 拍着翅膀说：“哭也是可以的！”Coco 说：“Crying is okay！哭是可以的！”咘咘点点头：“哭不是坏事。”
pages.text_en: NONO flapped his wings. "Crying is okay too!" Coco said, "Crying is okay!" Bubu nodded. "Crying is not a bad thing."

pages.text: 妈妈说：“情绪过后，还可以修复：道歉、抱一下、一起收拾、再试一次。这样，心里就慢慢晴起来了。”
pages.text_en: Mummy said, "After a feeling, you can also repair: say sorry, hug, tidy up together, and try again. Then your heart slowly clears up."

pages.text: 晚上，咘咘靠在妈妈身边说：“今天我的心里有晴天、暴雨和小雨。我都给它们起了名字。”妈妈亲了亲她：“你做得真好。”
pages.text_en: At night, Bubu leaned against Mummy. "Today my heart had sunshine, a rainstorm and light rain. I gave them all names." Mummy kissed her. "You did so well."

pages.text: 咘咘知道，天气还会变，情绪还会来。没关系，下一次，她可以先说出它的名字，再用小工具慢慢等一等。
pages.text_en: Bubu knew the weather would change again, and feelings would come again. That was okay. Next time, she could name the feeling first, then use her little tools and wait slowly.
